SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
March 28, 1935 REGISTRY.
No. D 6612
Date 28 / 3 / 35

MEMORANDUM ON H. J. CONNOLLY

Hugh Joseph Connolly was born in Birmingham,
England, on September 12, 1901. He joined the 2nd
Battalion, The Wiltshire Regiment, as a private soldier
on October 11, 1920, and served with this regiment
until December 11, 1929, when he was taken on the
strength of the Municipal Police as Probationary
Sergeant No. 351.

On September 24, 1931, Connolly was dismissed the
Force after appearing before the Commissioner of Police
on charges of (1) Neglect of Duty, (2) Corrupt Practice,
and (3) Neglect of Duty. In connection with this
matter he was also charged in H.B.M.'s Police Court with
Aiding and Abetting a Robbery but was acquitted owing to
lack of corroborative evidence.

Four Chinese Constables, who were concerned with
Connolly in the affair, were sentenced to terms of
imprisonment ranging from four months to five years.

Although Connolly was entitled to an indulgence
passage to England he chose to remain in Shanghai.

During the local Sino-Japanese hostilities of 1932
he joined the Shanghai Volunteer Corps and was attached
to Corps Headquarters where he acted as escort to motor
cars. While serving in this capacity he was suspected
of being concerned in the larceny of jewellery from a
house off North Soochow Road, but nothing was ever
proved against him.

In March, 1933, Connolly applied for and was granted
boarding-house and restaurant licence for premises
No. 111, Route Road. It was later ascertained that
apart from being the licensee he had no connection with
the establishment, and that he had obtained the licence
for the Chinese proprietor in return for free board and
lodging. In April, 1934, he attempted to transfer the
licence to No. 113, Route Road, but the transfer was

上海公共租界工部局警务处
1935年3月28日 登记室。
编号 D 6612
日期 35年3月28日

关于 H. J. CONNOLLY 的备忘录

休·约瑟夫·康诺利（Hugh Joseph Connolly）于1901年9月12日出生于英国伯明翰。他于1920年10月11日以列兵身份加入威尔特郡团（The Wiltshire Regiment）第二营，并在该团服役至1929年12月11日，当日他被录用为工部局警务处试用巡官，警号351。

1931年9月24日，康诺利因被指控犯有（1）玩忽职守、（2）贪污舞弊以及（3）玩忽职守，在警察总监面前受审后被开除出警队。在此事相关问题上，他还曾在英王陛下警察法庭被控协助和教唆抢劫罪，但因缺乏佐证证据而被判无罪。

与此案有关的四名华捕被判监禁，刑期从四个月到五年不等。

尽管康诺利有权享受遣返英国的优待船票，但他选择留在上海。

在1932年当地中日冲突期间，他加入了上海万国商团，并被派往商团总部，担任汽车护卫。在此期间，他被怀疑参与了一起发生在北苏州路附近某住宅的珠宝盗窃案，但从未查出确凿证据。

1933年3月，康诺利申请并获发了位于罗特路（Route Road）111号的寄宿舍及餐馆执照。后经查明，除了作为持照人外，他与该场所并无其他关联，他是为了换取免费食宿而为中国业主获取了该执照。1934年4月，他试图将执照转移至罗特路113号，但该转移未获

（批：见 D.R.O. 档案 710936 (Tor 巡长)）
